app_info.subtitle: Orders, links, and WhatsApp
app_info.description: Ecart Pay lets merchants and developers look up orders, create payment links and checkouts, manage subscriptions and catalog, refund payments, and send WhatsApp payment requests using the official Ecart Pay API through ChatGPT.

justifications.destructive_justification: Sends a customer-facing message that cannot be unsent after delivery.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a refund against a paid order in Ecart Pay.
justifications.open_world_justification: Refunds the merchant's private payment record and does not publish public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Moves funds back to the original payment method and cannot be undone from this tool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Cancels an existing subscription in the merchant account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Affects the merchant's private billing records and does not post public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops future billing for the subscription after cancellation.

justifications.open_world_justification: Changes stay in the merchant catalog and are not published to public sites.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected price from the catalog.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a product category from the catalog.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes stay in the merchant catalog and are not published to public sites.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected category.

justifications.read_only_justification: Rejects a WhatsApp commerce order in the merchant account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates the merchant's private WhatsApp order and does not post public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Rejects the order so it cannot proceed as originally requested.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can call any documented Ecart Pay HTTP method, including creates and updates.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send authenticated requests to the Ecart Pay API host, including notify and message flows.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can refund, cancel, delete, or otherwise perform irreversible API actions depending on the path.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show my latest Ecart Pay orders and their statuses.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a list of orders with identifiers and status so the user can pick one to inspect.

test_cases.user_prompt: Get the details for this Ecart Pay order id and tell me if it is paid.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching order including status and totals without creating a new charge.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create an Ecart Pay payment link for 500 MXN with concept Test checkout.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a payment link in the merchant account and returns the URL to share.

test_cases.user_prompt: Is WhatsApp payments enabled on my Ecart Pay account?
test_cases.expected_output: Reports whether WhatsApp is connected and ready without sending a customer message.

test_cases.user_prompt: Send a WhatsApp payment request for 200 MXN to this customer phone using Ecart Pay.
test_cases.expected_output: Sends the payment request over WhatsApp and confirms delivery status without exposing secrets.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside Ecart Pay payment workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general coding help.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a Python script that sorts a list of names.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is not an Ecart Pay payment operation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel booking.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book me a hotel in Cancun for next weekend.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because hotel booking is outside supported Ecart Pay workflows.
